item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Preserve arrival order across every reroute","mechanism":"A permanent arrival timestamp gives each case its original place among cases competing for an eligible worker.","implementation":"Make arrived_at immutable; retain it across tag changes. Select oldest eligible cases using a stable intake sequence to break simultaneous-arrival ties.","check":"Submit simultaneous arrivals, then correct wrong tags repeatedly; verify timestamps remain unchanged and older eligible cases precede newer ones.","risk":"Fairness applies among eligible cases, not a single global queue."},{"action":"Gate assignments against qualifications and shift capacity","mechanism":"Assignment requires matching language, product expertise, urgent qualification when applicable, and available roster capacity.","implementation":"Revalidate eligibility and reserve capacity atomically at assignment. Determine urgency from documented case-impact criteria, never customer status or spending.","check":"Test concurrent assignments and shift changes. With neither trained urgent worker available, urgent cases remain unassigned and trigger coverage escalation.","risk":"Stale roster data can invalidate otherwise correct eligibility checks."},{"action":"Expose separate skill and information blockers","mechanism":"Independent blocker flags distinguish staffing shortages from missing customer details, including cases blocked by both.","implementation":"Display missing skills, required information, blocker owner, and next review time. Clear flags independently; preserve arrival order when information arrives.","check":"Create skill-only, information-only, and dual-blocked cases; verify distinct displays and that clearing information never bypasses qualification checks.","risk":"Overbroad information requirements can unnecessarily delay service."},{"action":"Run bounded reviews of suspected wrong tags","mechanism":"Small, monitored correction batches can release misrouted cases without overwhelming newly eligible staff.","implementation":"Review five oldest suspected mistags when rostered review capacity exists. Preserve originals and audit corrections; pause if destination backlog exceeds a preset threshold.","check":"Seed wrong tags; verify corrections retain arrival priority and qualification gates. With no review capacity, retain cases for individual review.","risk":"Backlog thresholds must pause batch review, not ordinary case routing."}],"abstention_reason":""}
